Class RequestAssembler

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.core.http.RequestAssembler
public final class RequestAssembler extends Object
Assembles EquinixRequest instances: instantiates the right request subtype for the operation's RequestType, derives the response JavaType from the resource's JSON class, and resolves the endpoint's URI template ({$token} placeholders) against the request's properties and path parameters.

Split out of the former monolithic Utils class; see ResponseHandler, ParameterMapper and SerializationHelper for the other request/response helpers.

Author:
ianjones

    • addRequestParams

      public static <T> void addRequestParams(EquinixRequest<T> equinixRequest) throws EquinixClientException
      Resolves the endpoint's URI template and HTTP method from the apiParams catalogue onto the request. Every {$token} placeholder in the endpoint's requestUri must resolve to a non-null request property or path parameter; an unresolved token fails fast with an EquinixClientException naming the token and endpoint rather than silently dispatching a malformed URI.
      Throws:
      EquinixClientException - if the endpoint is unknown or a URI token cannot be resolved
